modifiers: bottom-right badge with a three-segment dashed circle surrounding a right-pointing play triangle
depiction.composition: single object in front view with a circular badge overlapping the lower right corner

readings.meaning: run process, script, or build pipeline

ambiguity: Can be read either as running an automated process/workflow or as configuring media/playback settings; at small sizes the segmented ring around the play triangle looks like a plain play button.

modifier_semantics.meaning: run, execute, automate, or media playback in progress

task_intents: set up home or work automation
run a deployment or build script
adjust video playback or streaming settings
schedule an automated recurring background job
fix a broken shortcut or macro

reasoning: The icon combines a gear (settings, system, mechanism) with a play triangle in a segmented progress ring (run, execute, media playback). It is a strong fit for tasks about automations, smart-home routines, CI/CD workflows, scripts, and playback settings, though it can be confused with a plain settings gear or generic video playback at small sizes.
